prompts.locationScope: Shepherd’s Glen Police Station, Alex’s closed cell before release by Wheeler
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE opaque static background plate for a 2D SIDE-VIEW fighting game, wide landscape 16:9, native 1672 by 941 pixels if possible.
Input images 1–3 are actual Silent Hill: Homecoming gameplay references of Alex's first cell in Shepherd's Glen Police Station, BEFORE Wheeler releases him. Reconstruct only this room's observed architecture, with a deliberate side-on camera adaptation. Remove Alex, Wheeler, every person, creature, weapon, flashlight hotspot, subtitle and HUD. Do not copy the unrelated hospital or penitentiary.
Scene: a small low-ceiling gray-green police holding cell. The main identifiable structure is a closed wall of thin straight gray steel vertical jail bars with two or three narrow horizontal rails and a closed barred door with a modest rectangular metal lock plate, continuing into a dark holding corridor behind it. Preserve the simple closely spaced bars, square metal frames, worn pale concrete/masonry walls, subdued dark lower wall band, rough cracked gray concrete floor and cold restrained illumination visible in the references. The barred structure belongs entirely BEHIND the gameplay plane, never in front of the fighters. No large gate pushed diagonally across the arena; all bars upright. The gate is closed and the lock intact. Any small broken flat slab fragments stay at the far rear edge or extreme outer corners; no rubble across the fighting lane.
Composition: perfectly level side-elevation camera, standing eye height, looking squarely at the rear barred wall, long horizontal room frontage with very shallow perspective, no centered vanishing corridor. Background wall and cage occupy the upper 70 percent. Broad continuous level concrete floor spans the lower 30 percent with an uninterrupted fighter footing line at normalized y=0.87. Keep the central 86 percent empty of props and obstacles. Room is modest and enclosed, with upper wall/ceiling shadow preserving its small scale. Do not invent elaborate unseen rooms; let them fall into darkness.
Materials and palette: realistic worn game-environment bitmap, muted cool charcoal, gray-green concrete, dull silver-blue bars, weak diffuse light. Enough midtone separation to see fighters. No smoke, flame, blood, flesh, ritual symbols, desk, modern office, posters, characters, toilet or bed added without source evidence. No text, UI, logos, watermark or border. Deliver one continuous empty environment, not a collage. Side-on camera and floor extension are authored adaptations; never claim exact 1:1.

prompts.locationScope: Kettenstadt Villa rooftop, first visit in fog, Maya’s mural and memorial
prompts.prompt:

Preserve the observed rooftop and the mural memorial scene. Image 1 and 2 define the aged rooftop stair-exit concrete wall and Maya's large mural; image 3 defines the ordinary low parapet/metal railing and faint neighboring roof details. Remove Anita and every living figure, phone, hand and subtitle completely. The girl depicted WITHIN the painted wall mural is wall artwork, not a character standing in the scene.
Scene: a weathered rectangular concrete rooftop with the broad painted wall facing us. Reproduce the reference mural's pale white/pink loose floral cloud over dark curved lower shapes, with the small centered pink-clad painted human motif embedded in the artwork, using its visible rough paint and muted colors; retain only the small adjacent dull green graffiti patch seen to one side. Many small pale bouquets and a few muted pink/red flowers sit in a low memorial strip directly against the wall below the mural, firmly behind the gameplay lane. The concrete wall is gray, stained, rough and rectilinear; never turn this into a Gothic facade or an industrial machine room. At the far sides, restrained low roof parapet/metal railing disappears into blue-green fog with barely visible adjoining roof shapes, following image 3. No open drop or cliff across the foreground and no rooftop edge through the fighting floor.
Composition: level SIDE-ON elevation camera, standing eye height, looking squarely at the mural wall; long horizontal shallow-depth stage. The mural occupies the central upper wall, flowers are kept at the wall's base BEHIND the playfield, no flower mound in the fighter lane. A broad continuous level damp dark concrete roof spans the bottom 30 percent, clear fighter footing at normalized y=0.87, unobstructed across the central 86 percent. One continuous empty roof surface with quiet diffused cold light and subdued wet sheen. No sunset, clear-sky ending, snow, pouring rain, lightning, pink petal storm or supernatural overgrowth.
Preserve the somber blue-gray/teal fog and desaturated source mural colors. No characters, creatures, bodies, jump reenactment, weapons, hazard, new readable message, UI, logo, watermark, border or montage. Render one finished realistic textured game background. Side-on camera, expanded blank roof area and hidden details remain authored adaptations, not a certified 1:1 reproduction.

prompts.locationScope: Kettenstadt Villa, normal concrete stairwell to the rooftop immediately after the chase exit
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE opaque static background plate for a 2D SIDE-VIEW fighting game, wide landscape 16:9, native 1672 by 941 pixels if possible.
Input images 1–3 are actual Silent Hill: The Short Message gameplay of the small NORMAL concrete stairwell leading to the Villa rooftop, reached after the maze chase. Image1 shows its entrance; images2–3 show the straight staircase, worn two-tone walls, slender wall handrail, low ceiling and weathered paneled door at the top. Use the ordinary stairs inside that doorway, NOT the paper-covered Otherworld corridor outside. Remove the hand, phone, subtitles, HUD and every person or monster.
Scene: an enclosed utilitarian apartment-block stair chamber. Preserve the simple straight flight of dark worn concrete steps, gray-green stained upper plaster over dull desaturated teal lower wall paint, thin dark handrail anchored to the wall along the slope, a low flat ceiling with a plain exposed beam/edge, and the rectangular aged roof-access door at the upper landing with its two pale horizontal inset/paneled sections and dark trim as in the reference. Paint is peeling in scattered irregular patches; restrained grime and a few plaster chips only at rear wall edges. No ornate balustrade, grand double staircase, spiral stair, huge atrium, chain-link fence, pipes, lockers, proliferating notices, religious icon, flowers or new graffiti.
Camera/composition: change to a perfectly level SIDE-ON elevation camera parallel to the long side of the stairs, showing one flight rising across the BACK of the room with its rail, and the small upper landing and closed door beyond. Keep the entire staircase, rail, landing and door BEHIND the gameplay plane. The bottom 30 percent is a clear continuous horizontal concrete lower landing extended across the image for a fighting lane, with fighter footing at normalized y=0.87. The central 86 percent of this foreground floor has no step, barrier, debris, gap or oblique railing. Avoid a first-person view looking UP the staircase and avoid a deep central vanishing corridor; we need a horizontal side-stage view with shallow depth and a readable stair silhouette in the back.
Lighting: cold weak gray-green light from above the upper landing, muted teal, slate and dirty cream materials, realistic textured abandoned game interior. Keep enough local contrast to distinguish fighters from the wall, without bright theatrical spotlights. No creatures, characters, nightmare skin, blood, flames, floating notes, lettering, UI, watermark, logo, frame or collage. Deliver one empty continuous room. Expanded lower landing and side camera are authored adaptations; geometry fidelity remains unverified.
